g.text: Overtake
If your opponent holds the centre
square, take that stone off the board
and back into their hand.
A Mountain is not safe from it.
Spend at the end of your turn.
Moved second only, one a game.
Overtake
If your opponent holds the centre
square, take that stone off the board
and back into their hand.
A Mountain is not safe from it.
Spend at the end of your turn.
Moved second only, one a game.
Relocate
Move one of your own stones to any
free square.
It resolves nothing on arrival.
Spend at the end of your turn.
Moved second only, one a game.

free square.

Spend at the end of your turn.
Moved second only, one a game.
Mirror
Swap what stands on two squares
symmetric about the centre.
Whoever owns the two stones.
Spend at the end of your turn.
Moved second only, one a game.

Mind Control
Name a stone in your opponent’s hand.
That is what they must play next turn.
You never touch the stone yourself.
Spend at the end of your turn.
Moved second only, one a game.

Rehearse
Resolve one of your stones on the
board again, from wherever it now
stands.
Not one the space has switched off.
Spend at the end of your turn.
Moved second only, one a game.
